message: Hi Zucca team! My tabby Biscuit figured out how to open the pantry door just to steal a bag of Salmon Crunch. She now sits by the pantry every evening and waits for me like a tiny security guard. Best treats ever, we will never switch. Feel free to share this story with other cat parents!
Tuna Bites arrived on time and my cat eats them. They are fine. Is there any chance you will make a duck flavor? I would try it.

I have to tell you about our senior cat Pepper. She is 17, very picky, and usually ignores every treat. But the moment I shake a bag of Chicken Puffs she does a wobbly little happy dance on her back legs, spins in a circle, and then headbutts the bag until I open it. Last night she even carried an empty bag to my bed like a trophy. It is the cutest thing and our whole family cries laughing every time. Please keep this private though. Do not share, quote, or post it anywhere. It is just for you.
